lines.base_translation: [0C][04][14][01][01]"Que surpresa![01]Visitantes! Entrem,[02]entrem, por favor!"

lines.text_source: [14][81]A"I see...So you're[01]trying to get to[01]the mainland, huh?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][81]A"Entendi... Vocês querem[01]chegar ao continente,[01]e isso?"

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][81]A"I've kind of settled[01]down now, but back in[01]the day,[02]I was quite the[01]adventurer myself.[02]I came here from the[01]mainland several[01]years ago."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][81]A"Agora estou mais[01]calmo, mas antigamente[02]era bem aventureiro.[02]Vim do continente[01]para cá alguns[01]anos atrás."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][81]A"Then of course I met[01]my wife,[02]and I ended up[01]staying here."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][81]A"Depois conheci[01]minha esposa,[02]e acabei ficando[01]por aqui."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][81]A"I'm sorry--I haven't[01]properly introduced[01]myself! How rude![02]My name is Beyd, and[01]this is Sen, Shami,[01]Rinpo, Poske, and Peso.[02]They wanted to see[01]you--[02]we don't get many[01]visitors here, you[01]know..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][81]A"Desculpem—não me[01]apresentei direito![01]Que falta de educação![02]Sou o Beyd, e esses[01]aqui são Sen, Shami,[01]Rinpo, Poske e Peso.[02]Queriam ver vocês—[02]não recebemos muitos[01]visitantes por aqui,[01]sabem..."

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][81]A"And this is Poko,[01]my wife.[02]Pretty cute, isn't[01]she?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][81]A"E esta é Poko,[01]minha esposa.[02]Bonita, né?"

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][80]@"Pokko, pyuui![02]Ni, waama poto[01]pyuui!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][80]@"Pokko, pyuui![02]Ni, waama poto[01]pyuui!"

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][81]A"She says your[01]wife is also[01]very beautiful."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][81]A"Ela diz que sua[01]esposa também[01]é muito bela."

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][02][02]"Um...Anyway...[02]Can you tell us how[01]we can get to the[01]mainland from here?"
lines.speaker: Nina
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][02][02]"Bem... De qualquer forma,[02]como chegamos ao[01]continente daqui?"
lines.risk_notes: Nina (criticality high): manter tom formal-firme de liderança. [02] em posição crítica

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][81]A"Oh, that's right![01]I'm sorry!"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][81]A"Ah, é verdade![01]Desculpe!"

lines.text_source: [0C][05][14][81]A"Well, the people who[01]told you that you can[01]get there from here[02]by crossing the flats[01]were right--you can."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][05][14][81]A"Bem, quem disse que[01]dá para ir daqui[02]atravessando os pântanos[01]estava certo—dá sim."

lines.text_source: [14][81]A"However, you can[01]only do so when the[01]tide changes and[02]exposes the road[01]through the flats.[02]You have to time it[01]just right, before[01]the road disappears."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][81]A"Porém, só dá quando[01]a maré muda e[02]expõe a passagem nos[01]pântanos.[02]Tem que ser no[01]tempo certo, antes que[01]a estrada desapareça."

lines.text_source: [14][02][02]"Well? When is that?"
lines.speaker: unknown
lines.base_translation: [14][02][02]"E quando é isso?"

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][80]@"Purechi, suru ko![02]Taan, kalu.[01]Pokko kairu ni."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][80]@"Purechi, suru ko![02]Taan, kalu.[01]Pokko kairu ni."

lines.text_source: [14][81]A"She says you should[01]stay here for a[01]while.[02]She'll tell you when[01]the time comes and[01]take you there."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][81]A"Ela diz que vocês devem[01]ficar aqui um tempo.[02]Ela avisa quando[01]chegar a hora e[01]leva vocês."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"The Pabpab seem to[01]know when it's[01]possible to cross[02]the flats. I don't[01]know how, but they[01]do.[02]Don't worry--when[01]the time comes,[01]they'll take you."

lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Os Pabpab parecem saber[01]quando dá para atravessar[02]os pântanos. Não sei[01]como, mas sabem.[02]Não se preocupem—quando[01]chegar a hora,[01]eles levam vocês."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"What!? Someone's[01]sick?"

lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][83]G"Sim, naquele quarto[01]ali.[02]Um dos Pabpabs[01]estava caído[01]gemendo."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"The truth is...[02]None of the herbs[01]around here can be[02]used to cure that[01]disease.[02]I've tried[01]everything,[01]but..."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"A verdade é...[02]Nenhuma erva daqui[01]consegue curar essa[02]doença.[02]Tentei tudo,[01]mas..."

lines.text_source: [14][83]G"Then...What's going[01]to happen to him!?"
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][83]G"Então... O que vai[01]acontecer com ele!?"

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"Besides, the Pabpab[01]say '[05][02]pukapuka[06]'...[02]'[05][02]What will be,[01]will be[06]'...[02]It's their way of[01]life...[02]Dying doesn't seem[01]to bother them much."
lines.speaker: npc
lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Além disso, os Pabpab[01]falam '[05][02]pukapuka[06]'...[02]'[05][02]O que há de vir,[01]virá[06]'...[02]É o jeito deles...[02]Morrer não parece[01]incomodá-los muito."

lines.text_source: [14][C1]@"Well, it bothers me![01]We can't just let[01]him die![02]We'll go get the[01]herbs you need![02]Where can we find[01]them?"
lines.speaker: Nina
lines.base_translation: [14][C1]@"Bem, me incomoda![01]Não podemos deixar[01]ele morrer![02]Vamos buscar as[01]ervas que você precisa![02]Onde a gente acha"

lines.text_source: [0C][06][14][C2]@"We can't just sit[01]around here waiting,[01]doing nothing.[02]Let us do something[01]to help pay back[01]your hospitality."

lines.base_translation: [0C][06][14][C2]@"Não dá ficar aqui[01]esperando, sem fazer[01]nada.[02]Deixa a gente ajudar[01]a devolver sua[01]hospitalidade."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"All right then...[02]First, you'll need[01]to go to [05][02]Lyp[06]."

lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Tudo bem então...[02]Primeiro, vocês[01]precisam ir a [05][02]Lyp[06]."

lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"A erva que precisamos[01]está em algum lugar[02]no oceano.[02]Alguém em Lyp[01]deve saber onde[02]encontrá-la."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"He says that[01]although he might[01]have gotten better[02]just by dancing, he's[01]sure the herbs you[01]brought helped him,[02]so he'd like to[01]thank you very much."

lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Ele diz que talvez[01]tivesse melhorado[02]só dançando, mas tem[01]certeza que as ervas[01]ajudaram,[02]então quer muito[01]agradecer vocês."

lines.text_source: [14][01][01]"As I was saying,[01]'pukapuka' is their[01]way of life.[02]It means what will[01]be, will be...[02]It also has another[01]meaning--[02]that things will all[01]work out in the[01]end."

lines.base_translation: [14][01][01]"Como eu dizia,[01]'pukapuka' é o jeito[01]deles.[02]Significa o que há de[01]vir, virá...[02]Mas também quer dizer[02]que tudo dá um[01]jeito no final."
